items.title: EU Directive on Empowering Consumers for the Green Transition enters into force: Everything you need to know
items.summary: The EU Directive on Empowering Consumers for the Green Transition (the ECGT or EmpCo Directive) becomes legally binding for businesses on 27 September.

items.title: 2050淨零目標倒數　永續教父揭卡關大魔王
items.summary: ▲台灣要在2050年達成建築淨零碳排，真正的難題恐怕不是「新建築怎麼蓋」，而是全台高達97％的既有建築如何改造。（圖／記者陳筱惠攝） 台灣要在2050年達成建築淨零碳排，真正的難題不是「新建築怎麼蓋」，而是高達97％的既有建築如何改造。

items.title: 2026台灣設計展《桃園演算室》　展現淨零城市想像
items.summary: 2026台灣設計展在桃園，市府環保局於桃園會展中心A9展區推出《桃園演算室TAOYUAN RE:CODE》，以「進入系統，用日常重新編碼城市未來」為主軸，規劃集體演算、動態演算及行動演算三大展區。展覽透過5公尺高藝術裝置、大型環狀即時生成藝術、碳排負重體驗及循環材料咖啡廳，帶領民眾看見生活選擇與城市淨零轉型之間的關係。

items.title: ESG Today: Week in Review
items.summary: This week in ESG news: EU publishes final revised sustainability reporting standards; Glass Lewis merges with Clarity AI to form unified stewardship and sustainability data platform; Bain survey finds rebounding consumer concern on sustainability, increasing sustainable consumption behavior; Schroders launches new framework to identify and assess climate adaptation investment opportunities; EU to launch sustainability criteria, labels for data centers; Germany unveils plan to exit fossil fuels by 2045; New York’s inaugural ESG bond offering; MSCI’s new Head of Sustainability, and more.
